subject: deps
text: - The arch bans stay as they are: C-building crates in `deny.toml`, and `tokio` in the sync crates' graph for three target triples in `deny-sync.toml`, run per sync crate as the sole root over the four crates of `scripts/sync-crates.txt` (arch §Build system). `viola-channel`, whose Tokio client (tokio `=1.53.1`, `io-util`) sits behind its `tokio` feature, left that list at chunk 2026-10-17-mcp-server-for-drivers and is covered instead by the `cargo tree` form `scripts/channel-tokio-free.sh` (its normal graph without the feature must print no `tokio v` line, its `--features tokio` control one; CI supply-chain step `Tokio ban per sync crate (sole root)`). Every ban, the tree form included (probe `channel-tokio-edge` and its channel control, `13/13 banned, control clean`), is proven live by `scripts/deny-probes.sh`.

subject: deps-supply-chain
text: - The open advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0386 (`unsound`) against the locked tokio `=1.53.1` fails CI's `supply-chain` job. It is owned by the working-route entry "tokio RUSTSEC-2026-0386 lock bump": a lock bump of `tokio` to `>=1.53.3`, with no ignore-list widening, so RUSTSEC-2017-0008 stays the only advisory ignore.
